# XPortalNetworks

> XPortalNetworks is interactive portal network and destination selection system for valheim, eliminating tag pairing and portal hubs. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Portal network routing, private portals, and destination UI selector**: Portal network routing, private portals, and destination UI selector.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal portal networks or routing tables**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal portal networks or routing tables.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/XPortalNetworks/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
